sleeve: ETF/Cross-Asset tactical allocation (NEW, orthogonal to stock ALPHA_RANKER)
method: Monthly rebalance. Score = 12m-minus-1m return (12-1 TS momentum). Hold top-50% ranked assets with POSITIVE momentum only (else cash), equal-weight. Signal at month t applied to forward return t->t+1 (lookahead-checked, see note).
lookahead_note: [DATA] First implementation applied signal(t) to the CONTEMPORANEOUS return ending at t (t-1->t), not the forward return -> inflated Sharpe to ~1.0-3.0. Fixed to fwd_rets = rets.shift(-1) before any number below was accepted. This is exactly the T-class lookahead the firm's LOOKAHEAD_CONTROLS taxonomy warns about; corrected result only is reported here.

full_history_1994_2026.caveat: [DATA] Dominated by 1994-2021 when GOLDBEES/SILVERBEES/NIFTYBEES did not exist on disk (or at all, for the ETF wrappers) - for most of this window the 'universe' was really SP500+NASDAQ+COPPER only, growing to +NIFTY50 (2013) then +GOLD (2021) then +SILVER (2022). Not a real tradable history for an India investor.
full_history_1994_2026.verdict_this_window: ROUGHLY TIED, rotation slightly WORSE on both Sharpe and maxDD

concurrent_only_since_2022_02.caveat: [DATA] Honest window: only period where ALL 6 core assets are simultaneously tradable on disk. LOW-N (53 monthly obs, ~4.4yr) - judge directionally, not on significance. Also: this window is a near-monotonic multi-asset bull run (no crisis episode), so it cannot test the crash-protection thesis of TS-momentum, only the cost/whipsaw side.
concurrent_only_since_2022_02.verdict_this_window: ROTATION CLEARLY WORSE - buy-and-hold Sharpe nearly 2x the rotation, maxDD statistically indistinguishable (rotation's usual crash-protection edge never got to show up because there was no crash in-sample)

factor_ic_pooled_asset_month.note: weak (|rho| 0.01-0.11) but SAME-SIGN in both windows for mom_12m and carry_trend at 1Y - the only directionally-stable factors found in this sleeve. n this small (6-asset cross-section) cannot support a real significance claim; treat as a soft prior, not an edge.

verdict: [INFERENCE] Simple 12-1 TS-mom + relative-strength rotation does NOT beat equal-weight buy-and-hold on Sharpe in the one honest (concurrent-universe) window available, and is only roughly tied over the noisy, mostly-non-tradable full-history window. The theoretical case for TS-momentum (drawdown protection in a crisis) is UNTESTED here because the concurrent window contains no crisis. Recommend: do not build this as an active rotation strategy on current evidence; if revisited, must be tested across a window containing at least one real drawdown (2020 COVID / 2022 hikes) using the raw index histories (not ETF-wrapper histories) to get enough crisis coverage, and pre-register the kill bar before looking.
